# Story 25 — KB-001 Knowledge Base Articles verification & gap closure (Story: CRM-64)

---

## Prerequisites

- Story 24 (`24-story-crm-102.md` in `.squad/plans/knowledge-base/`) reviewed for the Knowledge Base categories / article-management shape and reused patterns.
- AUTH-003 permission model (see `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/Permissions.cs` and `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/RolePermissions.cs`) understood before touching any authorization.
- Customer Portal contracts (`backend/CRM.Api/CustomerPortal/CustomerPortalEndpoints.cs`, `backend/CRM.Api/CustomerPortal/CurrentCustomerAccessor.cs`) reviewed — customer identity resolution must match the existing convention.
- Note: the KB module already exists on disk (`backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/`, `frontend/CRM.Web/src/modules/knowledgeBase/`, tests in place). This story is a **review + gap-closure** pass to guarantee every CRM-64 acceptance criterion is met; it is **not** a green-field implementation. Do not rebuild what is already present.

---

## Story Goal

Guarantee the Knowledge Base Article MVP satisfies every CRM-64 acceptance criterion end-to-end:

1. Article CRUD (title, content, category, author-from-server) works for authorized CRM users only.
2. Draft vs Published lifecycle works via dedicated `publish` / `unpublish` endpoints; publishing stamps `PublishedAt`, unpublishing clears it and forces `Status = Draft` without deleting content.
3. Customer Portal exposes **only Published** articles; requesting a draft by id returns 404 without revealing existence.
4. List endpoint supports `page` / `pageSize` pagination; management UI paginates.
5. Frontend management view (list + create/edit + publish/unpublish) and customer-facing article view are responsive and localized (EN LTR / AR RTL).
6. All backend and frontend tests for the above pass.

Not in scope: search, versioning, approval workflows, comments, ratings, analytics, slugs, AI generation, article-to-ticket suggestions.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Author is server-determined.** Request bodies never contain `AuthorId`; the backend reads the caller identity from the authenticated principal.
- **Status enum is exactly `Draft` and `Published`.** No other values.
- **Publish** → `Status = Published`, `PublishedAt = UtcNow`.
- **Unpublish** → `Status = Draft`. Do **not** clear `Content`. Do **not** hard-delete the article. `PublishedAt` may either be cleared or retained; pick whichever the existing code already does and document it in code comments.
- **Draft is invisible to customers.** Customer requests for a draft id must respond with 404, indistinguishable from a non-existent id.
- **Category is validated.** Reject unknown / deleted category ids with a 400/404 per the project's convention (match how other endpoints in `Program.cs` and the customers module reject unknown FKs).
- **Pagination is server-driven.** `page` (1-based) and `pageSize` with a maximum cap; management UI never fetches all articles.
- **Frontend must not be the only guard.** Every mutation endpoint enforces the KB manage permission server-side even if the UI already hides the button.

### 2 — Verify endpoints & authorization

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseEndpoints.cs`

For each route below, confirm — and fix if wrong:

- `GET /api/knowledge-base/articles?page=&pageSize=` — CRM users see all; returns `{ items, total, page, pageSize }`. Requires KB read permission.
- `GET /api/knowledge-base/articles/{id}` — CRM user gets any article; return 404 when missing.
- `POST /api/knowledge-base/articles` — requires KB manage permission; author id resolved from `HttpContext.User` (do not read `AuthorId` from the body).
- `PUT /api/knowledge-base/articles/{id}` — requires KB manage permission; updates `Title`, `Content`, `CategoryId`, `Status`. Set `UpdatedAt = UtcNow`.
- `POST /api/knowledge-base/articles/{id}/publish` — requires KB manage permission. If already published, return 204 (idempotent) or 409 — match the project's existing convention seen in other lifecycle endpoints (see `TicketEndpoints.cs`). Set `Status = Published`, `PublishedAt = UtcNow`, `UpdatedAt = UtcNow`.
- `POST /api/knowledge-base/articles/{id}/unpublish` — requires KB manage permission. `Status = Draft`, `UpdatedAt = UtcNow`. **Do not** null the content.
- Category existence: reject unknown/deleted `CategoryId` with `ProblemDetails` matching the customers module's style.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Empty / whitespace title or content.** Validated in `KnowledgeBaseEndpoints.cs` create + update handlers; return 400 with a `ProblemDetails` referencing the field. Frontend blocks submit with disabled button.
- **Invalid `CategoryId`.** Backend must lookup the category and reject with 400/404. Verify in `KnowledgeBaseEndpoints.cs`.
- **Deleted category.** If categories support soft delete, treat as invalid on create/update; existing articles keep their category id but the frontend must degrade gracefully (show category id or a fallback label).
- **Customer requesting a draft.** `CustomerPortalEndpoints.cs` portal getter returns 404 for both missing and non-published articles. **Never** 403 — do not reveal existence.
- **Publish while already published / unpublish while already draft.** Idempotent — return the current article without changing timestamps unnecessarily. Match the pattern used elsewhere (see how tickets handle repeated status transitions in `TicketEndpoints.cs`).
- **Concurrent update.** EF Core will throw `DbUpdateConcurrencyException` if a `RowVersion` column is present. If it is not, document that "last write wins" is the MVP behaviour. Do not add concurrency tokens in this story unless the codebase already uses them for KB entities.
- **Large content.** Backend column type must be `text` (unbounded) — verify in the migration / snapshot. Frontend textarea does not truncate.
- **Arabic RTL content.** Article view uses `dir="auto"` on the content container so mixed-language content renders correctly.
- **Unauthorized mutation attempt.** Endpoint returns 403 (or 401 if unauthenticated). Regression-test in `RbacEndpointEnforcementTests.cs`.
- **Author user deleted.** Endpoint should still return the article; response tolerates a missing author (return the stored `AuthorId` and a null display name).

## Migration / Rollback

- If you added a new EF migration (task 5 in Backend), name it `AddKnowledgeBaseIndexes` (or similar), commit both `.cs` and `.Designer.cs`, and update the model snapshot.
- Rollback: `dotnet ef database update <previous-migration>` inside `backend/CRM.Api`. Because no data is dropped, downgrade is safe.
- Half-applied state: if the new migration is applied but the code deploy is rolled back, the extra indexes are harmless.
- If no schema change was needed, delete any accidental migration file before committing.

1. **Backend builds:** `dotnet build` in `backend/`.
